topic: What are the status of militants in Pakistan over the last year and what would be the outlook for conflicts involving militants in Pakistan going into 2025?
initial_thesis: Balochistan, Not KP, Is Pakistan’s New Insurgency Epicenter
final_thesis: Sharpened dual-center conflict: In 2024, Balochistan became the volume hub of militancy—driven by Baloch separatist IEDs, abductions, and infrastructure attacks centered in Kech/Gwadar/Quetta—while Khyber Pakhtunkhwa evolved into the lethality hub, with TTP-led shootings and armed clashes in the Waziristan–Kurram–Bannu belt producing late-year fatality surges. Entering 2025, expect sustained high-frequency, infrastructure-disruptive violence in Balochistan with periodic spikes, and continued high-lethality clashes in KP—especially if Afghan-side permissiveness endures—yielding a bifurcated risk profile: disruption-heavy in Balochistan, casualty-heavy in KP.
